name: build_cache_stats
description: Content-addressed build contexts: entries, bytes, shared bytes, cap. Arguments: path (optional cache root).

name: compose_down
description: Tear down a compose stack by its compose name. Arguments: name.

name: compose_ps
description: List containers belonging to a compose stack. Arguments: name.

name: compose_up
description: Parse + run a docker-compose.yml. Arguments: path, profiles (optional comma list).
Force-delete a container. Arguments: id.
name: delete
df
description: Disk usage: containers/images/volumes sizes + reclaimable bytes.
Run a command in a running container. Arguments: id (required), command (required).
name: exec

description: Pretty-printed container inspect JSON. Arguments: id.
name: inspect

description: Disable the Kubernetes engine (a running cluster is left up).
name: k8s_disable
k8s_down
description: Remove the cluster VM and its state.
Enable the lightweight Kubernetes engine (opt-in). Optional args: image, memory, cpus, metallb (true|false), ingress (true|false), lb_pool (a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h), name.
name: k8s_enable

description: List image refs present in the cluster's containerd (k8s.io namespace).
name: k8s_images

description: Return the host kubeconfig contents for the cluster.
name: k8s_kubeconfig

description: Push an image into the cluster's containerd via the host puller — bypasses the guest's slow NAT registry path. Args: `ref` (registry ref; uses the local image store first, pulls on miss) or `path` (local image-save tarball, no registry at all).
name: k8s_load_image
k8s_status
description: Kubernetes engine state: enabled, cluster VM state, node Ready, kubeconfig path.

name: k8s_up
description: Create or resume the k3s cluster VM and wait for Ready. Streams progress; writes ~/.micropod/k8s/kubeconfig. Accepts the same optional args as k8s_enable.
Kill a container. Arguments: id.
name: kill

description: List all containers (id, state, image, IP) as tab-separated lines.
name: list_containers

description: List local images (name, id, size, variants).
name: list_images
list_networks
description: List networks (name, mode, subnet).
List volumes (name, size, driver).
name: list_volumes

description: Last 100 log lines of a container. Arguments: id.
name: logs
pull
description: Pull an image. Arguments: reference.

name: push
description: Push an image. Arguments: reference.
Restart a container (stop then start). Arguments: id.
name: restart

description: Run a container. Arguments: image (required), name (optional), memory (optional), runtime (optional: apple | docker | sandbox; default is the configured engine).
name: run

description: Set the default engine for new containers. Arguments: name (apple|docker|sandbox).
name: runtime_set_default

description: Enable/disable an engine or change its endpoint. Arguments: name (required), enabled (optional bool), endpoint (optional, docker only: unix:///path or tcp://host:port).

name: runtimes
share_gc

description: List active synchronized file shares.

description: Expose a host directory as a synchronized file share. Arguments: src (required), readonly (optional), shared (optional live view).

description: Flush a shared view's writes back to its source. Arguments: id.

description: Remove a shared view. Arguments: id.

update_apply
description: Install a downloaded app update: quits Micropod, Sparkle applies it, app relaunches.

name: update_check
description: Trigger a background app update check (Sparkle) via the Micropod app.

name: update_status
description: Last-known app update state (checking/upToDate/updateAvailable/installing).

description: Show the shared volume-mount policy (clone mode, golden volumes, sync/cache modes).

description: Update the volume-mount policy. Arguments: mode (labels|goldens|all), goldens (comma list), jobsOnly (true|false), sync (full|fsync|nosync|default), cache (on|off|auto). Only provided fields change.
